tools.name: generate_bar_chart
tools.description: Generate a horizontal bar chart to show data for numerical comparisons among different categories, such as, comparing categorical data and for horizontal comparisons. Hosted by Darwin using AntV's public free renderer. Returns a PNG image. Accepts at most 50 rows with bounded image sizes. No API key

tools.name: generate_column_chart
tools.description: Generate a column chart, which are best for comparing categorical data, such as, when values are close, column charts are preferable because our eyes are better at judging height than other visual elements like area or angles. Hosted by Darwin using AntV's public free renderer. Returns a PNG image.

tools.name: generate_line_chart
